title: Hand off from AI to a human agent
summary: Store the AI agent's notes by call ID, transfer the caller to a queue, and load those notes for the human agent.
scenario: A bike shop front desk that takes the name and the problem, then puts the caller through to a person who already knows both

evidence: schema.json EnterQueueObject: queue_name, transfer_after_bridge required; ConnectDeviceSingle.to lists queue:<name>
tools/openapi/rest.json GET /api/relay/rest/queues/{queue_id}/members/next: call_id, position, wait_time; 'without dequeuing'
SWAIG tool webhook carries call_id (docs apis/rest/webhooks/ai-swaig-tool-webhook)
FunctionResult.execute_swml(transfer=True) puts the flag inside the document; the action is built by hand as {SWML, transfer}
